title: Playboy Magazine January 1970 Holiday Anniversary Raquel Welch McGovern
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; cover wear, scuffs, creases and edge/corner wear consistent with a magazine of this age. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, January 1970 - Holiday Anniversary Issue. Cover price $1.50.

Featuring Senator George McGovern, Tennessee Williams, Arthur J. Goldberg, Irwin Shaw, Bruce Jay Friedman, Justice William O. Douglas, Graham Greene, David Halberstam, Art Buchwald, Harvey Cox, Julian Bond, Mort Sahl, Robert Morley, Cesar Chavez, Jean Shepherd and Tom Wicker.

Also: Playboy's Playmate Review, an interview with Raquel Welch, plans for a posh new Playboy Penthouse, How to Throw a Wild Roman Revel, and Vargas Revisited.
